text: 10 OVERDOSAGE In previous clinical studies, three deaths were reported in patients with severe hemochromatosis who were treated with daily intramuscular Ca-DTPA dosed up to 4 gram per day to reduce iron stores. One patient became comatose and died after receiving a total of 14 grams Ca-DTPA, and the other two died after two weeks of daily treatment. Causal association with these events and the drug has not been established. [See Warnings and Precautions (5.4) ]
